redistribution: Rows with shipped false are identities, recorded and not shipped: CM1-AUTHORITY.json's redistribution record names 'fourteen tar-only runtime assets have no standalone license sidecar' as a blocker, and its package policy is to ship identities and maps rather than CM1 runtime assets; the caller supplies such a file from their own r21.1 extraction and the package verifies it against the sha256 recorded here. Rows with shipped true are CM1's own supercell and squall_line namelists, shipped byte for byte as the GUI's examples under the CM1 r21.1 release grant quoted in NOTICE; they are text configuration files, not among the recorded blockers, and their digests are the ones tools/authority/cm1r21.1-content-sha256.tsv (in the source distribution) records for the pinned tarball.
